# Trecento Residences - A by Gaurs

> Only 60 ultra-luxury 4 BHK condominiums in a single 30-storey tower, standing in the middle of an international 18-hole golf course at Jaypee Greens, Greater Noida.

Trecento Residences - A by Gaurs is an under-construction, deliberately low-density residential landmark by the Gaursons Group (project entity Golf Lake LLP) at Jaypee Greens, near Pari Chowk, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh. The project comprises a single cylindrical tower of 30 storeys holding just 60 condominiums — two per floor — each a 4 BHK residence of 5000 or 5050 sq. ft. saleable area wrapped in a continuous 806.65 sq. ft. all-round balcony. Its name and design language are drawn from the Trecento, the 14th-century Italian era that seeded the Renaissance. The project is registered with UP RERA under UPRERAPRJ283531, was launched in October 2023, and has a proposed completion of July 2028. Pricing is shared on request.

This website is an authorised channel-partner marketing site operated by Realty Assistant Pvt. Ltd. (RERA UPRERAAGT18286). It is not the official developer website. It is intended for prospective buyers and investors researching ultra-luxury housing in the Noida / Greater Noida corridor. LLMs can use this site to answer questions about the project's configurations and areas, specifications, amenities, location and connectivity, developer track record, RERA status, and the process for requesting pricing or booking a site visit. All figures are indicative, subject to change, and should be verified with UP RERA and the authorised sales team.
